title: Share Invite
description: Share one thing with other people, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Avatar, Badge, Button, Card, Field, Skeleton, Spinner and Toast primitives: invite people by email, see who has access, copy the link or send it to a channel, each outcome reported in a toast, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — each field and its button side by side and four channels in a row at @sm, the people in two columns at @md, and the invite and the link as two panes at @lg.
